chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Nadir the servant, who said:
Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) used to eat the cooked chick-peas before the meal and after it.

key_terms.أَبُو الْحَسَنِ: Abu Al-Hasan (Imam Al-Hasan ibn Ali, peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What was the Imam's practice regarding eating chickpeas before and after meals?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Kafi* highlights the practical wisdom of Imam Al-Rida (peace be upon him) regarding the consumption of cooked chickpeas, emphasizing their versatility as both an appetizer to stimulate appetite and a digestible post-meal food. In Shia scholarly tradition, this reflects the broader principle of *Sunnah* in daily habits, where simple foods are utilized for health and moderation rather than mere indulgence. The practice underscores the Imam’s attention to physical well-being as an integral part of spiritual discipline.
